name: Recipe Scaler
summary: A small command-line tool that scales a recipe to a different number of servings and converts units.
targetReason: It is a code project with tests to run, so Claude Code can build and check it directly.
goal: Scale any plain-text recipe to N servings with sensible rounding and optional metric or imperial output.
audience: Home cooks comfortable running a command in a terminal.
deliverables: A CLI that reads a recipe file and prints the scaled version
Unit conversion between metric and imperial for common kitchen units
Tests covering parsing, scaling and rounding
A README with install and usage instructions
constraints: Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux
No network access at run time
doneWhen: Scaling the sample recipes gives the expected output in tests
The README example works as written on a fresh machine

files.purpose: What the tool does, how to install it and how to use it.
A sample recipe used in the README and tests.
